localFactor.unit: × (1 = same as the source-country basis of the v1 unit costs)

importMarkup.source: DUMMY. Customs duty, freight and insurance on imported equipment (PLAN_V1 Appendix G)

ownersCost.source: DUMMY. Engineering, permits and project management (PLAN_V1 Appendix G)

gridConnectionUsd.unit: USD, only if a stream makes power
gridConnectionUsd.source: DUMMY. Transformer, line and connection charges (PLAN_V1 Appendix G)

decommissioning.unit: fraction of project capex, paid in the last year

insurance.unit: fraction of project capex per year

staffCostInr.unit: INR per person-year, fully loaded (9 lakh)

rtoFrac.unit: fraction of stream capex per year, without labour
